tv: Skyworth / Coocaa 8R40_K5C (Realtek rtd285x, 1 GB, 32-bit), China domestic firmware
notes: `com.tianci.*` / `com.coocaa.*` firmware, not the `com.smartdevice.*` Google-TV Skyworth below; 16 packages: Coocaa ad engine, push, app store, Baidu Oases, mall, activity center, browser, PiTV, weather, blockchain and smart-home preloads (six already ship disabled); **keep `com.coocaa.sky.ccapi`**, and never disable `com.tianci.de` and `com.skyworthdigital.stb.dataprovider` in the same batch: that crashes About this TV, which holds the only ADB toggle, and recovery is a factory reset, so install Activity Launcher first (`coocaa.intent.action.TIANCI_FACTORY`); no stock package declares HOME and the boot target comes from `/system/pcfg` plus `/system/etc/bootintent.xml`, so never disable `com.tianci.movieplatform` (black screen) — a third-party launcher can be booted by pointing both files at it (needs root, see the device guide); boot ad off with `persist.sys.bootvideo.time 1`; with an accessibility helper on, any text field can crash its app because the firmware has no clipboard service; debloat only; reboot-checked; [device guide](../docs/devices/skyworth-8r40-k5c.md)
